verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a public GraphQL Platform API for interacting with workflows and automating processes. It also ships SDKs, scoped API access and programmatic agent management. Live probes confirm a published llms.txt for the Platform API docs and an OpenAPI spec endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the product through the API (no community reports on API use), and specifics such as rate limits and auth flows are not shown in evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: An expressive GraphQL API to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!
Use our flexible APIs, SDKs to build custom apps and integrations tailored to your  unique needs.
Run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code, anywhere you need it.
